title: SRS Package Manifest (ext:repository)
description: Index manifest for a local file-based SRS package. Declares identity, lists relative paths to field, type, view, and relation-type definition files, and records dependency references to other packages. Governs the package/ directory layout within an ext:repository.

id.description: Stable UUID for this package. Never changes across versions.

name.description: Machine-readable package name within the namespace, kebab-case.

dataModelRevision.description: RFC-033 / #265 — the data-model generation this package's definitions were authored/generated for. Absent means revision 0. Distinct from the package's own semver version. RFC-043 is the migration toRevision 8 (container members become ordered entries; rootInstanceIds and Composition memberOrder removed); a package carries Compositions, so its memberOrder is migrated with it (RFC-043 [R17]). Not dotted semver.

description.description: What this package provides and who it is for.

fields.description: Relative paths from this package directory to field definition files, e.g. fields/title.json.

types.description: Relative paths from this package directory to type definition files.

views.description: Relative paths from this package directory to L1 View definition files (ext:views-l1). Omit or use empty array if the package defines no Views.

compositions.description: ext:views-l2 — relative paths from this package directory to Composition definition files. Omit if the package defines no Compositions.

themes.description: ext:themes-l1 — relative paths from this package directory to Theme definition files. Omit if the package defines no Themes.

relationTypes.description: Relative paths from this package directory to relation-type definition files. Omit if the package defines no relation types.

vocabularies.description: Relative paths from this package directory to Vocabulary definition files (RFC-006).

lifecycles.description: Relative paths from this package directory to Lifecycle definition files (RFC-006).

blueprints.description: Relative paths from this package directory to Blueprint definition files (ext:blueprint). Omit or use empty array if the package defines no Blueprints.

protocols.description: Relative paths from this package directory to Protocol definition files (ext:protocol). Omit or use empty array if the package defines no Protocols.

packageDependencies.description: The packages this package requires (DependencyRef[]), keyed by packageId; absent means it requires nothing. Not the list of definition References a bundle's content points at, which is the bundle's dependencyRefs (RFC-044 [R7]). A consumer MAY check each entry against the repository's installed packages and reports an unsatisfied entry as package-dependency-unsatisfied, never as a load failure (RFC-044, ext:repository).
packageDependencies.$comment: srs-rust#873/#910: renamed from `dependencyRefs` (srs#478, rfc-decision-c8704763 item 2) — the fold rides srs-rust#910's shared dataModelRevision 6 stamp per the map's accepted (unvetoed) proposal on srs#524. The old name is read only by the `composition-cutover` migration (#6), never the runtime load path. RFC-044 (srs#855): entries are keyed by the required package's packageId (successor decision to rfc-decision-c8704763's package-dependency sentence); no dataModelRevision bump, existing entries repaired directly.

DependencyRef.description: A requirement on another package (RFC-044 [R1]). packageId is the key; namespace and name are display labels and never decide whether the requirement is satisfied. version is a SemVer 2.0.0 string: an installed version satisfies it when it is in the same compatibility band (same MAJOR; below 1.0 the same 0.MINOR; for 0.0.z the same release), is not a pre-release of a different release, and has equal or higher precedence (RFC-044 [R3]).

packageId.description: The id of the required package: the value its package manifest carries as id and its bundle carries as packageId. The key of the requirement.

namespace.description: Display label: the required package's namespace. Never used to decide satisfaction.

name.description: Display label: the required package's name. Never used to decide satisfaction.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version the requiring package is authored against; satisfied by an installed version under the RFC-044 version rule ([R2], [R3]).
